_comment: Provenance + integrity record for every model weight on jarvis (todos.md #45). We pin image versions rigorously ('no :latest' is a stated quality bar) and used to pin model weights not at all -- a silently swapped, truncated, or corrupted GGUF was undetectable. verify-models.sh re-hashes these weekly and alerts on mismatch, AND flags any .gguf on the host that is missing from this file. Hashes captured 2026-07-22. Weights themselves stay out of git (huge, gitignored); this manifest is what is committed.
_license_honesty: Where upstream terms were not verified from the source repo at capture time, the field says so rather than guessing. An honest 'unverified' is a work item; a guessed license is a liability -- and this repo is heading for open source (todos.md #14).
_ignore_reason: ggml-vocab-* are tiny tokenizer fixtures shipped inside the llama.cpp source tree, not served models.

models.name: bge-m3
models.license: unverified — upstream BAAI/bge-m3 is MIT, but the GGUF conversion repo this file came from was not recorded at download time (2026-06-18)
models.notes: The KB interoperability standard: 1024-dim Cosine. Every kb_* collection is embedded with it, so replacing this file invalidates every collection -- which is exactly why its integrity is worth checking.
